seen.title: A faster, lighter C# Dev Kit (11.0 pre-release)
seen.notes: 6-project .NET 10 solution (ParcelTrack) exercising the rearchitected C# Dev Kit: single Native AOT CSDevKit process + project caches. Measured stable 3.40 vs pre-release 11.x side by side on the VM: warm solution load 6.9s -> 0.52s, 5 server processes -> 1, ~80% less memory.
